coverage: Whole group totals; no product-level profit allocation
incomeDefinition: Interest earned plus other income, including insurance premium and other operating income from insurance businesses. This is gross group income before interest expense, insurance claims, operating expenses and provisions; it is not sales or net interest income.
definition: Consolidated net profit after tax, share of associates where applicable, and deduction of profit attributable to minority shareholders. Minority shareholders own stakes in group subsidiaries; their earnings are excluded from this profit figure.
location: PDF page 1 · consolidated section, year ended 31 March 2026 column, rows 1–3 and 12–17
notes: Use the consolidated annual column, not the adjacent standalone or quarterly columns. Reported group PAT before adding associates and deducting minority interest is ₹85,168.47 crore; the statement adds ₹1,497.20 crore of associates’ profit and deducts ₹3,366.89 crore of minority interest. Group totals include insurance and other subsidiaries. Individual loan-product profits are not inferred.
insight: Total income measures the size of group income before major costs. For the bank’s lending engine, investigate standalone interest spreads, deposit costs and bad-loan provisions; also separate exceptional gains from recurring earnings when comparing annual PAT.
